怎么判断变化来自哪里: Identify the source of a change
把上午、当地正午、下午各记录一次：太阳方向、太阳高度、影子方向、影长。影子方向与: Record solar direction, solar altitude, shadow direction and shadow length in the morning, at local noon and in the afternoon. A shadow points opposite the Sun's horizontal direction. For one vertical gnomon, a higher Sun gives a shorter shadow. Changing “Ground Magnification” changes only display scale, not physical shadow length. Use the same display magnification when comparing two gnomons and rely on the numerical values.

If clipping arrows appear, reduce magnification or choose a higher solar position; an off-screen shadow is not an absent shadow.

想看一天内的位置变化，点击“月球天空”，再选择空间、俯视方位、地平或仰望天空视角: To see motion during a day, select “Moon Sky,” then choose spatial, overhead-azimuth, horizon or Looking Up view. Set playback to “Time within a Day.”
从月球模式进入“关联图解”，选择“月相与关系”“逐日照明比例”或“月出月落”。先: Enter Related Diagrams from Moon mode and choose “Phases and Relationships,” “Daily Illuminated Fraction” or “Moonrise and Moonset.” Confirm the title says “Moon · Related Diagrams,” then adjust date and time directly on that page.
选择“行星伴月”标签，选一颗行星；固定地点与时刻，按日期比较角距。也可使用“找未: Select “Moon–Planet Pairing” and choose a planet. Fix location and time and compare angular separation by date. You can also use “Find Closest Day in the Next 30 Days,” then read the altitude and visibility guidance.
月相原理图与逐日观察分别怎么用: Using the phase-principle diagram and daily observations
进入月相画面，先看地球、轨道上的月球、平行太阳光和旁边的月面示意；球体大小与距离: Open the phase diagram and inspect Earth, the Moon on its orbit, parallel sunlight and the adjacent lunar-disk illustration. Body sizes and distances are not to scale.
用鼠标或手指拖动轨道附近的月球，连续查看相位变化。这个操作同时改变实际日期与时刻: Drag the Moon near its orbit with a mouse or finger to follow phase changes continuously. This also changes the real date and time. To compare different dates strictly at the same time, use the date slider below while keeping time fixed.
每隔几天记录一次日期、月相名称和照明比例。月相周期约29.53天，不等于一个历月: Every few days, record date, phase name and illuminated fraction. The phase cycle is about 29.53 days, not one calendar month. Continue across months using the calendar; do not expect every month's first day to be a new moon.
切到月球天空，观察同一天里月球的高度和升落；再改日期比较同一时刻。月球日轨迹仅覆: Switch to Moon Sky to observe the Moon's altitude and rise/set during one day, then change the date to compare at the same time. A daily lunar path covers only 00:00–24:00 and usually does not close at its ends.
原理图的大月面是固定朝向示意，不能用它直接判断本地天空里亮面朝左还是朝右。真实天: The large lunar disk in the principle diagram has a fixed illustrative orientation; it cannot directly tell you whether the bright side is on the left or right in your local sky. Use Looking Up for the actual sky orientation. Hemisphere and viewing direction change the disk's orientation on-screen. A small Moon–planet angular separation does not guarantee naked-eye visibility; check altitude, daylight and the page's guidance.
任务单：一个月里固定时刻观察: Worksheet: observe a month at one fixed time
选定地点、月份与20:00当地真太阳时，暂停播放。每隔约3天改变日期，记录月相名: Choose a location and month, set 20:00 local apparent solar time and pause. Change the date by roughly three days at a time; record phase, illuminated fraction, lunar altitude and indicators such as “Below the Horizon.”
找到最接近新月、上弦、满月、下弦的日期，再用相邻日期细看。不要预设这些月相必定发: Find the dates nearest new moon, first quarter, full moon and last quarter, then inspect adjacent dates more closely. Do not assume those phases occur on a particular lunar-calendar or Gregorian-calendar day; use the ephemeris readings.
选一个月球在地平线上的日期，保持日期不变，拖动一天内的时刻。比较月相比例与天空位: Choose a date when the Moon is above the horizon and keep it fixed while moving the time through the day. Compare illuminated fraction with sky position: rising and setting are daily motion; the main phase period is about 29.53 days, although illumination also changes slowly during a single day.
切“月相”原理图或三维日地月，在同一时刻核对照明比例。外部相机看到的亮面、固定朝: Check the illuminated fraction at the same instant in the phase-principle diagram or 3D Sun–Earth–Moon view. The bright side seen by an external camera, a fixed-orientation phase diagram and the lunar disk's rotation in the local sky represent different viewing arrangements.
不要把“满月”解释为月球自己发光，也不要把月相解释为地球影子遮住月球；这里的常规: Do not explain full moon as the Moon producing its own light, or ordinary phases as Earth's shadow covering it. These diagrams show sunlight and viewing direction; eclipses require additional occultation conditions and are not simulated by this model.
在太阳界面直接选择“仰望天空”；在月相界面先点击“月球天空”，再选“仰望天空”。: In the Sun interface, select Looking Up directly. In Moon Phases, first select Moon Sky, then Looking Up.
用方位滑块或东南西北按钮转向，用时刻滑块改变观测时间。这两个操作分别改变朝向和时: Use the azimuth slider or cardinal-direction buttons to turn, and the time slider to change observation time. These operations change direction and time separately.
点击参数区的天体名称，让画面转向它。月面亮边会随当地天空方向转动；月相原理图仍是: Click a body's name in the parameter area to face it. The Moon's bright limb rotates with the local sky orientation; the phase-principle diagram keeps a fixed orientation. If a body is not visible, first read indicators such as “Behind You” or “Below the Horizon.”
在太阳界面需要对比月球时，展开“显示辅助”，开启“叠加月球视运动”，再固定地点、: To compare the Moon in the Sun interface, expand Display Aids, enable “Overlay the Moon's Apparent Motion,” then compare at fixed location, date and time.
记录时把“朝向”和“时刻”分开：先固定时刻，只改变面向方位，找到各天体；再固定朝: Record viewing direction separately from time. First fix time and turn to find each body; then fix direction and change time to see bodies rise, fall or leave the view. Planets drawn in daylight indicate position, not guaranteed naked-eye visibility. A body below the horizon cannot be seen directly from that location.
地面方位参考盘标出北、东、南、西，蓝点表示观察者站位，金色箭头表示正前方。拖动转: The ground-direction disk marks north, east, south and west. A blue dot marks the observer and a gold arrow points straight ahead. When you drag to turn, both the grid and direction labels change projection: facing south puts east on the left and west on the right; facing east puts north on the left. This is a directional aid, not an orbit, and it does not change body altitude. Direction at the poles follows a reference convention.
轨迹为什么没有接到地平线？: Why does the path not meet the horizon?
点击仰望天空视角上方“轨迹说明”。图中地平线是高度0°，不是天体会落到的实体表面: Select “Path Explanation” above Looking Up. The horizon is altitude 0°, not a physical surface on which bodies land. Orthographic projection gives curved left and right boundaries to the forward hemisphere. A path is clipped when it passes behind you, which need not happen at altitude 0°. The Moon's 00:00 and 24:00 endpoints may also remain above the horizon; they are not necessarily rise/set times.
可固定北京夏至附近的日期，先面向南，再转向东、北、西。东北日出和西北日落处于面向: Fix a date near the June solstice in Beijing and face south, then east, north and west. Northeastern sunrise and northwestern sunset are behind you when facing south, so the visible solar path's ends can lie above the horizon. In this project, geometric rising or setting occurs only when a body's center crosses altitude 0°.
任务单：月球与行星的同场观察: Worksheet: observe the Moon and planets together
先固定地点、日期与时刻，用四个方位按钮查找太阳、月球和行星，再点击天体名称对准它: Fix location, date and time. Use the four direction buttons to find the Sun, Moon and planets, then click a body's name to face it. Read its altitude to check whether it is above the horizon.
保持朝向不变，只拖动时刻，记录天体何时进入、离开前方半球。把“在身后”与“在地平: Keep direction fixed and move only the time. Record when bodies enter or leave the forward hemisphere. Distinguish “Behind You” from “Below the Horizon”: you can turn to see the former; the latter cannot be seen directly there at that time.
在月球模式开启行星伴月，记录月球与所选行星的角距，再查看双方高度和日照条件。角距: In Moon mode, enable Moon–Planet Pairing and record the angular separation from the selected planet. Check both altitudes and daylight conditions. A small separation means similar directions, not small physical distance or guaranteed naked-eye visibility.
画面上方选择日晷类型与“立体装置／盘面与安装”。晷上读时紧贴图形，时间和日期只用: Choose the sundial type and “3D Instrument / Dial and Installation” above the drawing. The dial reading stays beside the diagram; use only the controls below for time and date. By default, drag the 3D instrument to rotate it and pinch or use the wheel to zoom. Dragging the shadow changes time only after you select “Drag Shadow to Set Time.” Reset View leaves location and observation time unchanged. Parameters are grouped by observation location, instrument settings, clock-time comparison and construction principles.
在太阳实验台的“关联图解”菜单中点击“日晷实验台”，进入独立实验页；再用页面顶部: Select Sundial Lab from the Sun lab's Related Diagrams menu to open the independent experiment page. Then choose Horizontal Sundial or Equatorial Sundial using the buttons at the top.
先选择“水平日晷”，设置地点和日期，拖动图形下方的时刻滑块。图形上方显示当前装置: Choose Horizontal Sundial, set location and date, and move the time slider below the drawing. The current “Dial Reading” appears above it; switching types updates the reading and explanation together. At night, it reports no direct solar shadow. Select “Drag Shadow to Set Time” to drag the shadow or click the scale; you can also play through a day.
固定日期与时刻，只改变“晷针长度”，记录影线变化和读时；再切换“赤道日晷”，重复: Fix date and time and change only gnomon length. Record the shadow-line changes and dial reading. Then switch to Equatorial Sundial and repeat the comparison.
切到“盘面与安装”查看安装图。需要动手制作时展开“制作、安装与原理”；需要对照钟: Switch to Dial and Installation for the installation drawing. Expand “Construction, Installation and Principles” to make a physical sundial. For a clock comparison, expand Clock-time Comparison, enter the UTC offset and read the result.
先固定地点与日期，分别选上午、正午附近和下午，记录晷上读时、影线方向和当前装置类: Fix location and date, then select morning, near noon and afternoon. Record the dial reading, shadow direction and instrument type. Dragging to rotate changes only the viewing angle; time changes only in “Drag Shadow to Set Time” mode. Changing gnomon length changes shadow length, which must not be mistaken for a change in time.
水平日晷的盘面水平，晷针方向平行地轴；赤道日晷的盘面平行赤道面，针与盘面垂直。安: A horizontal sundial has a horizontal dial and a gnomon parallel to Earth's axis. An equatorial sundial has a dial parallel to the equatorial plane and a gnomon perpendicular to it. Install it according to local latitude and hemisphere, not merely the apparent tilt on-screen. Enter the correct UTC offset for clock comparison; daylight-saving time is not applied automatically. If the reading says “No Direct Solar Shadow” or is unreadable, first choose a time when the Sun is above the horizon, then check installation conditions.
任务单：装置、影子和钟表读数: Worksheet: instrument, shadow and clock readings
选北京和太阳在地平线上的时刻，先用“立体装置”旋转查看盘面和晷针。水平日晷是盘面: Choose Beijing and a time with the Sun above the horizon. In 3D Instrument, rotate to inspect the dial and gnomon. The horizontal type has a horizontal dial and an axis-parallel gnomon; the equatorial type has an equator-parallel dial and a perpendicular gnomon.
记录09:00、12:00、15:00三个真太阳时的影线和晷上读时。刻度受装置类: Record shadow lines and dial readings at 09:00, 12:00 and 15:00 apparent solar time. Scales depend on the instrument type; do not apply a horizontal sundial's scale pattern to an equatorial dial.
切“拖影调时”，拖动影子后看下方时刻是否同步；再切回旋转装置，检查旋转不应改变日: Select “Drag Shadow to Set Time,” drag the shadow and check that the time below updates. Switch back to instrument rotation and verify that rotating does not change date or time.
填写钟表时对照的UTC偏移，分别记录晷上读时和钟表时。差异需要结合经度与均时差解: Enter the UTC offset for clock comparison and record both dial and clock times. Explain the difference using longitude and the equation of time rather than assuming the sundial is broken. Across seasons, check the illuminated side of the equatorial dial and any unreadable indication.
比较针长时固定其余条件。针长改变影线长度，而影线方向所对应的刻度不应因此变成另一: Keep all other conditions fixed when comparing gnomon lengths. Length changes the shadow-line length; it should not change the time indicated by the shadow's direction.
在太阳页面顶部的小字导航中点击“日行迹”，进入独立实验页。原菜单入口也继续保留。: Select Analemma in the small top navigation on the Sun page to open its independent experiment. The original menu entry remains available.
参数区把“固定时刻的依据”选为钟表时，设置 UTC 偏移；在图形下方设置每日固定: In Parameters, set “Basis of Fixed Time” to Clock Time and enter the UTC offset. Set the daily fixed observation time below the diagram. Drag dates or play day by day and follow the marker around the annual path.
保持地点和时间依据不变，分别设置 09:00、12:00、15:00；也可开启三: Keep location and time basis fixed and try 09:00, 12:00 and 15:00. You may also overlay all three times. Drag the 3D diagram to inspect another direction, or use Reset Sky View.
再把依据切到“当地真太阳时”，记录轨迹怎样改变；每次记录中写明采用哪一种时间依据: Switch the basis to Local Apparent Solar Time and record how the path changes. State the time basis in every record.
展开“高级实验 · ‘8’字的成因”，启用理想成因实验。先只把倾角调到 0，再恢: Expand “Advanced Experiment · Causes of the Figure Eight” and enable the idealized cause experiment. Set only obliquity to 0, then restore reference values; set only eccentricity to 0 and restore them again. Finally, compare with both set to 0.
调参数时只滚动参数框，全年图形始终保留在上方或旁边。完成成因实验后关闭理想开关，: Scroll only within the parameter panel while changing settings; the annual diagram stays above or alongside it. Turn off the idealized experiment when finished, then resume real-date observation.
怎样记录成因比较: How to record the comparison of causes
先在真实日期模式完成一整年、同一钟表时的观察，再启用理想成因实验。记录每一轮的地: First observe a complete year at one clock time in real-date mode, then enable the idealized cause experiment. For each run, record location, time basis, fixed time, obliquity, eccentricity and path features. Change one parameter at a time and restore reference values afterward. Setting obliquity or eccentricity to 0 isolates an influence in an idealized model; it does not alter the real year's ephemeris.
改观测时刻时，先观察太阳在本地天空的位置和投影方向，再比较整条轨迹。三维投影可能: When changing observation time, first inspect the Sun's local sky position and projection direction, then compare the entire path. A 3D projection may overlap lines; rotate it or switch coordinate views. Dashed sections are below the horizon. Today's solar marker does not mean the Sun is visible on every date of the year. Fixed apparent solar time and fixed clock time are different bases and must be recorded separately.
任务单：为什么会有“8”字: Worksheet: why a figure eight appears
先关闭理想实验，固定地点、钟表时依据、UTC偏移与12:00。遍历全年，记录几个: Turn off the idealized experiment and fix location, Clock Time, UTC offset and 12:00. Scan the full year, noting points near solstices and equinoxes and their positions on the curve. Dashed parts lie below the horizon.
把时间改成09:00再改成15:00。先比较轨迹在天空中的位置，再旋转三维查看形: Change time to 09:00, then 15:00. Compare the path's sky position before rotating the 3D view to inspect its shape. Overlapping projections do not mean the time change failed.
恢复同一时刻，改为当地真太阳时。此时太阳时角固定，均时差造成的东西向年度摆动被消: Restore one fixed time and switch to Local Apparent Solar Time. Solar hour angle is now fixed, eliminating the annual east–west variation caused by the equation of time. Do not expect the same figure eight as under clock time.
在理想成因实验中先记录参考状态，再只将倾角设0；恢复参考值，再只将偏心率设0；最: In the idealized cause experiment, record the reference state, then set only obliquity to 0. Restore it, then set only eccentricity to 0; finally set both to 0. Use the same location, time and projection at every step and describe which parts of the curve change.
“大环在下、小环在上”不能脱离坐标和观看方向直接判断。相机旋转、时刻与投影会改变: “The large loop is below and the small loop above” is not meaningful without coordinates and viewing direction. Camera rotation, time and projection change their screen positions. Check the axis labels, months and selected coordinate system first.
入口在“实验台 → 关联图解 → 空间模型”，或关联图解页的“空间模型”菜单；也: Enter through “Lab → Related Diagrams → Spatial Models,” the Spatial Models menu on Related Diagrams, or the 3D Sky top link. Choose 3D Solar System for the eight planets or Sun–Earth–Moon Relationships for Earth and Moon directly. This page uses independent UTC time and does not change the original lab's location, date or time.
先选“太阳系”，暂停播放，在参数区选择一颗行星，读出平均太阳距离、平均公转周期和: Choose Solar System, pause playback and select a planet in Parameters. Read its mean solar distance, mean orbital period and radius. Use the blue “Observe … Up Close” button to inspect its sphere; select Solar System to return to the overview.
拖动画面旋转相机，滚轮或双指缩放。旋转只改变观察角度，不改变日期或真实天体坐标；: Drag to rotate the camera and use the wheel or pinch to zoom. Rotation changes only the viewing angle, not the date or physical coordinates. The upper-right reset button restores the current view. On a computer, arrow keys rotate and plus/minus keys zoom.
在图形下方拖动日期轴，或使用日历定位。日历定位到所选日期的12:00 UTC，连: Drag the date axis below the drawing or use the calendar. The calendar selects 12:00 UTC on the chosen date; continuous dragging and playback retain fractional-day time. Read the UTC time beside the date rather than interpreting it as local apparent solar time.
固定相机，设置每秒推进的天数，点击播放，比较同一时间间隔内内外行星的运动。取消“: Fix the camera, set days advanced per second and select Play to compare inner and outer planets over the same interval. With “Loop Current Year” off, playback stops at the year's date-axis endpoint. Use the calendar to select another year before a cross-year observation.
切换“日地月”，开启“平行太阳光线”，比较太阳方向箭头与光线方向：箭头指向太阳，: Switch to Sun–Earth–Moon and enable Parallel Sunlight. Compare the arrow toward the Sun with the light rays: the arrow points to the Sun, while rays travel in the opposite direction toward Earth and Moon. Change dates to observe the Moon's spatial position and geocentric illuminated fraction. The illuminated side seen by an external camera is not automatically the phase seen from Earth.
手机点击标题旁“参数”打开侧拉菜单，调完后关闭再继续看图。触屏拖动实时旋转，双指: On a phone, select Parameters beside the title, adjust the drawer and close it to continue observing. Touch dragging rotates in real time; pinching does not change the date.
沉浸式全屏观察：保留控制，让画面占主位: Immersive full-window observation: keep controls while prioritizing the view
链接打开满窗口布局；在三维页点击“沉浸观察”时，支持的浏览器也会进入系统全屏。S: opens a full-window layout. Selecting Immersive Observation on the 3D page also requests system fullscreen in supporting browsers. If Safari or another browser does not support or allows no fullscreen, the full-window layout remains usable.
顶部保留太阳系／日地月切换，底部保留UTC、播放、日期与滑条。详细参数点击右上角: Solar System / Sun–Earth–Moon selectors remain at the top; UTC, playback, date and slider remain at the bottom. Open detailed settings with Parameters at the upper right, then close them to rotate and zoom again. There is no second set of time controls.
先暂停，转动相机找到要看的天体，再点名称或通过“观察 → 天体近景”靠近。需要舒: Pause first and rotate the camera to find your object, then select its name or use “Observe → Body Close-ups.” For a gentler demonstration of position changes, choose 2 days/second in Parameters. This is accelerated time, not real-time celestial motion.
开启轨道便于辨认公转路径；需要干净画面时关闭轨道或名称。日地月中开启“地轴与赤道: Enable orbits to identify orbital paths; turn off orbits or names for a clearer view. In Sun–Earth–Moon, enable Axis and Equator to distinguish the red axis, blue equator ring and ecliptic reference plane.
按“退出沉浸”返回正常布局；键盘Esc先关闭已打开的参数菜单，再退出沉浸。退出只: Select Exit Immersive to restore the normal layout. Esc closes an open parameter drawer first, then exits immersion. Exiting changes only layout: it does not reset bodies, camera or UTC, and does not automatically start playback.
The background catalog contains 61,816 HYG stars with J2000 directions. Normal mode shows the 8,920 stars with apparent magnitude ≤6.5; immersive mode extends to ≤8.5. Magnitude controls brightness, and color index approximates blue-white versus warm colors. No atmospheric twinkling is added in this spatial view. Glow, point size and exposure are display treatments, not stellar diameters or precision astrometry. This mode shares the original ephemeris and renderer and does not enable an automatic orbiting camera. Fix the camera before playing to distinguish physical position changes from changes in viewpoint.
卫星、小行星与真实星云影像: Moons, asteroids and real nebula images
进入沉浸模式，打开右下角“观察 → 太阳系与深空细节”。卫星群、主带小行星、周期: In immersive mode, open “Observe → Solar System and Deep-sky Details” at the lower right. Satellite groups, main-belt asteroids, periodic comets and nebula backgrounds have separate switches. New objects appear as unnamed points by default to avoid covering the diagram.
在太阳系总览比较各行星附近的卫星群；水星、金星没有已知天然卫星。选择一颗行星后，: In the Solar System overview, compare satellite groups near each planet. Mercury and Venus have no known natural moons. After selecting a planet, choose Observe Selected Planet's Moons to frame the planet and its available orbital-data points more clearly. Select Solar System to return to the overview.
当前快照包含JPL轨道表中八大行星的455颗卫星。它是可用轨道数据的覆盖范围，不: The current snapshot contains 455 moons of the eight planets from JPL orbital tables. This is coverage of available orbital data, not a continuously updated worldwide discovery count. Apart from the Moon and Jupiter's four Galilean moons, motion is approximated from fixed mean orbital elements. Use it to observe prograde/retrograde motion and spatial distribution, not predict occultations or precise encounter times.
主带层包含按JPL绝对星等筛选的1,200颗小行星，并非整个小行星带；彗星层包含: The main-belt layer contains 1,200 asteroids selected by JPL absolute magnitude, not the entire asteroid belt. The comet layer has 12 elliptical-orbit periodic comets. Both appear only in the Solar System overview and share the existing UTC controls. Point size, brightness and compressed distance are not physical observing quantities.
星云背景默认关闭；可选的“星云影像背景”使用真实公开望远镜影像，在对象大致方向放: Nebula backgrounds are off by default. Optional Nebula Image Backgrounds use real public telescope images, enlarged in approximately their source directions; their screen extent is not their true angular diameter. Select View Real Nebula Images to browse Orion, the Ring Nebula and Mystic Mountain in the Carina Nebula, with original public images and sources.
星云是远处星际气体与尘埃结构，不是行星卫星，也不在太阳系内部。这里的多波段与处理: Nebulae are distant interstellar gas and dust structures, not planetary moons or objects inside the Solar System. These multi-band and processed-color images are not naked-eye views. Turn off the background to continue using catalog stars as directional references. Planet–Moon comparisons use angular separation on the celestial sphere: apparent closeness does not imply closeness in physical space, nor does it guarantee visibility to the unaided eye.
月相原理图明确表示平行太阳光。固定朝向的原理示意与当地“仰望天空”中的亮边方向分: The lunar-phase diagram explicitly shows parallel sunlight. The fixed-orientation geometric illustration is handled separately from the bright limb’s orientation in the local ‘Looking Up’ view. The latter is projected according to location, time, and viewing direction, rather than using a simplified rule that directly flips left and right in the Southern Hemisphere.
地面观察视角把高度0°地平线、天顶、观察方向和天体位置放到同一画面。方位参考盘与: The ground-level view places the 0° altitude horizon, zenith, viewing direction, and celestial positions in one scene. The directional reference disk and ground grid change as you turn, helping learners distinguish turning around from a celestial body moving.
画面表示前方半球的正投影，轨迹可以因视野边界或当日时间端点而在地平线上方结束。它: The scene is an orthographic projection of the forward hemisphere. A path may end above the horizon because it reaches the field-of-view boundary or an endpoint of the day’s time interval. This does not mean a body falls onto the ground, and does not necessarily indicate an omitted segment. A geometric rise or set occurs when the body’s center crosses 0° altitude. Disk sizes aid identification, and plotting a planet’s direction during daylight does not mean it must be visible to the unaided eye.
日影采用水平地面与竖直立杆。影长随太阳高度变化，影子方向与太阳的水平分量相反；显: Shadow calculations assume horizontal ground and a vertical stick. Shadow length changes with solar altitude, and its direction is opposite to the Sun’s horizontal component. Display magnification changes only the extent of the ground scene; readings in meters remain the lengths in the model. The stick-tip path throughout a day and the shadow-tip path at a fixed time throughout a year describe daily and annual changes respectively.
日晷的晷针平行地轴，不能与竖直日影杆混为一谈。水平日晷盘面水平，晷针仰角等于当地: A sundial’s gnomon is parallel to Earth’s axis and must not be confused with the vertical stick used for shadow experiments. A horizontal sundial has a horizontal dial plate, with the gnomon elevated at an angle equal to the absolute value of the local latitude. An equatorial sundial’s plate is parallel to the equatorial plane, and its gnomon is perpendicular to the plate. The separate workbench provides device, dial-face, and installation views, with readouts and explanations synchronized to the current sundial type.
可读时条件与夜间、赤道退化或阳光平行晷面等条件分别说明。日晷读当地真太阳时；指定: Conditions under which the sundial can be read are explained separately from nighttime, degeneration at the equator, or sunlight parallel to the dial plate. Sundials show local apparent solar time. A clock comparison with a specified UTC offset helps explain differences caused by longitude and the equation of time.
日行迹表示同一地点、每天同一时间定义下的太阳位置。固定钟表时通常形成经典“8”字: An analemma shows the Sun’s position at the same location each day under the same definition of time. A fixed clock time usually produces the classic figure eight, with Earth’s axial tilt and orbital eccentricity both contributing. Fixing local apparent solar time removes the hour-angle oscillation caused by the equation of time, so the same curve should not be expected.
真实日期模式提供全年位置与不同投影；独立的理想成因实验允许分别改变倾角与偏心率，: Actual-date mode provides annual positions and different projections. A separate idealized cause experiment lets you change tilt and eccentricity independently to investigate their contributions. These idealized parameters affect only this experiment and do not overwrite the main workbench’s actual ephemeris. Changing observation time preserves the camera view, so automatic recentering does not obscure positional differences.
独立三维天空展示八大行星与日地月关系，可旋转、缩放、选中天体、观察近景和历史轨迹: The separate 3D sky module displays the eight planets and Sun–Earth–Moon relationships. You can rotate, zoom, select bodies, inspect close-up views, and explore historical paths. Original diagrams and their 3D comparisons share the parent page’s time controls: local apparent solar time is converted to the same UTC instant to drive the 3D scene, while camera changes leave observation conditions unchanged. The separate 3D page has its own UTC clock and can be paired with a top-down spatial view or local-sky reference.
沉浸观察让图形占据窗口，保留日期轴、播放、退出和参数入口。系统全屏不可用时仍有满: Immersive observation expands the scene to fill the window while retaining the date axis, playback, exit, and parameter controls. 沉浸模式可显示卫星群、主带小行星、周期彗星与真实星云影像。光点没有密集名称，随所: Immersive mode can show satellite populations, main-belt asteroids, periodic comets, and actual nebula imagery. Earth/Moon and the other objects are rendered in two passes with a shared depth buffer, isolating their parallel and point lights. Ray picking includes both layers.
